[operation: tenant-get]



READ-ONLY



Fetches top-level config and metadata for the authenticated org — the tenant is inferred from the API key, so there are no inputs. Use it to learn the org's subdomain and cluster, which other calls fold into URLs and identifiers.

→

    {tenantData: {tenantId, cluster, subdomain}, tenantType: "Personal"|"Organization", email (Personal only), domains: [...] (Organization only)}

  Note: tenantId is at tenantData.tenantId (not top-level); subdomain is at te
